meta.title: Angular Acceleration Converter — Convert Radian/second² and More
meta.description: Free angular acceleration converter for 4+ units including Radian/second², Degree/second², Revolution/second². Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: rad/s², deg/s², rev/s². Convert between 4 angular acceleration units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for angular acceleration in this tool is **radps2**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most angular acceleration conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Radian/second² | rad/s² |
| Degree/second² | °/s² |
| Revolution/second² | rev/s² |
| Revolution/minute² | rev/min² |
content.use_cases:
- Reading datasheets where SI and imperial units appear side by side.
- Cross-checking CAD drawings against fabrication specs in a different system.
- Converting torque, pressure, or stress values for procurement.
- Translating field measurements into engineering reports.
- Spec'ing parts from international suppliers.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this angular acceleration converter?
**A:** It uses 4 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Radian/second² (rad/s²), Degree/second² (°/s²), Revolution/second² (rev/s²), Revolution/minute² (rev/min²).
